data.animaCaption: Kneeling forward on the deep red sofa with her unbuttoned white uniform shirt slipping off her shoulders over a lavender lace bra, she braces one hand on the cushion and meets your gaze in flustered shyness. Warm indoor lamp light catches her braided white-rose ornament and loosened brown suspender skirt.
data.promptProse: Captured in a close tilted horizontal event-CG composition across a plush crimson sofa inside the closed café lounge, Shiki Natsume kneels forward with one hand pressed into the cushion. Her hair is gathered into a braided side ponytail pinned with a white rose and purple ribbon; her white uniform shirt hangs unbuttoned off her shoulders to expose a delicate lavender lace bra above her loosened brown suspender skirt and black thighhighs, her normally cool face deeply flushed beneath warm amber wall light.
data.story: 打烊后的休息室只亮着角落一盏暖灯。夏目单手撑在深红沙发靠垫上，白衬衫顺着肩头松散滑开，向来冷静的琥珀色眼睛此刻写满了难得的动摇与羞怯。
